resources.string: Mirror this phone to your Windows PC
View-only: your PC can see this screen while you stream, but it can never tap, type or control your phone. Nothing leaves your local network.
Open OpenScreen on your PC and scan the QR code it shows.
Connect to the same Wi-Fi network as your PC.
Checking that video can reach your PC.
Tap Start streaming and choose “Entire screen” to show your phone on the PC.
Connection interrupted. Trying again (attempt %1$d)… Your stream continues when it comes back.
Higher settings need a strong Wi-Fi signal. Quality adapts automatically when the network is busy.
This phone\'s video encoder does not report 60 FPS at 1080p, so 30 FPS is used.
Point the camera at the QR code in the OpenScreen window on your PC
This isn\'t an OpenScreen code. Scan the code shown in the OpenScreen window on your PC.
Your PC uses a newer version of OpenScreen. Update OpenScreen on your phone.
This OpenScreen code couldn\'t be read completely. Scan it again.
%1$s (%2$s). Nothing is shared until you tap Start streaming.
Warning: your phone does not seem to be on the same network as this PC. Connect both to the same Wi-Fi if the connection fails.
Screen sharing wasn\'t allowed. Tap Start streaming again and choose “Entire screen”, then Start.
OpenScreen needs the camera only to scan the QR code. You can paste the pairing link instead.
Connect your phone to the same Wi-Fi network as your PC, then scan the code again.

The connection timed out. Your Wi-Fi may block devices from talking to each other (common on guest, hotel and campus networks), or Windows Firewall is blocking OpenScreen. Allow OpenScreen on Private networks, or use a different network.
OpenScreen on your PC may have been closed or restarted. Open it and scan the new QR code.
The PC that answered is not the one in the QR code. Scan the code currently shown on your PC. If this keeps happening, something on this network may be intercepting traffic — use a different network.
Something other than OpenScreen answered at this address. Scan the code currently shown on your PC.
Your phone and PC run incompatible versions of OpenScreen. Install the same release on both.
Each code works once. Scan the code currently shown on your PC.
Codes expire after 5 minutes. Scan the new code on your PC.
Your PC is already showing another phone. Stop that session first.
Wait a minute, then try again.
The PC didn\'t answer in time. Try again.
Your PC can\'t decode this phone\'s video format. Update Microsoft Edge WebView2 on the PC.
Connected, but video can\'t get through
Your PC was reached, but the video connection (UDP) was blocked. Allow OpenScreen through Windows Firewall on Private networks, set the network to Private, or try another Wi-Fi.
The connection didn\'t come back within a minute. Scan the QR code on your PC again.
The viewer on your PC was closed. Scan the code again to start a new session.
Your PC sent something this app doesn\'t understand. Make sure both apps are up to date; if it continues, please report a bug.
An unexpected error occurred. Try again; if it continues, please report a bug.
Your screen is visible on your paired PC.
